ghi: Cảnh Thang máy phim #132 theo ngữ pháp ReelShort (tham-khao/reelshort.md) + SƠ ĐỒ CẢNH 2D (so-do-canh.ts): một thang máy, Hạ đứng chắn cửa, Vivian vào từ lối vào phía phải toàn cảnh, Lục Thần bước ra từ chính thang đó. Mọi hướng trên màn tính từ sơ đồ ({A→B}), mỗi cắt có cớ (noi-nhip.ts), hành động tiếp xúc có mảnh hai người cùng khung. kf = keyframe dùng lại.

bt: Sơ mi trắng dính cà phê
shot.hd: Toàn sảnh: Hạ ôm thùng đứng chắn trước cửa thang máy thép, chờ
shot.anh: Wide establishing shot of the black marble elevator lobby: one brushed-steel elevator door in the back wall, a floor indicator above it, the lobby opening toward the right. Hạ, in a white blouse with a coffee stain and a staff ID badge on a dark blue lanyard, stands alone right in front of the closed elevator door hugging a cardboard box of her belongings.
shot.vid: Hạ waits, shifting the box in her arms. Static camera.
shot.mo: Hạ stands still in front of the closed elevator door, hugging the box
shot.ket: Hạ lifts her eyes to the floor indicator above the door

bt: Sơ mi trắng dính cà phê
shot.hd: Cận Hạ: nghe tiếng giày cao gót, liếc về phía lối vào
shot.anh: Close-up of Hạ, calm, her eyes turned {Lâm Hạ→loi_vao} toward the sound of approaching heels, the elevator door blurred behind her.
shot.vid: Hạ hears heels approaching and keeps her eyes {Lâm Hạ→loi_vao}, wary. Static camera.
shot.mo: Hạ's eyes come down from the floor indicator
shot.ket: Hạ's eyes settle {Lâm Hạ→loi_vao} on the approaching footsteps

bt: Sơ mi trắng dính cà phê
shot.hd: Vivian từ lối vào đi tới chỗ Hạ, nhếch môi
shot.anh: Wide shot of the same lobby: Vivian in a fitted burgundy office dress strides in from the lobby opening, heading for Hạ, who stands with her box in front of the elevator door; Vivian's eyes are fixed on Hạ with a smug half smile.
shot.vid: Vivian walks in {Vivian→Lâm Hạ}, eyes locked on Hạ, smug. Static camera.
shot.mo: Vivian is already striding in from the lobby opening
shot.ket: Vivian slows to a stop beside Hạ, looking {Vivian→Lâm Hạ} straight at her

shot.hd: Cận Vivian: nhìn thẳng Hạ, cười khẩy
shot.anh: Close-up of Vivian, smug half smile, her eyes looking {Vivian→Lâm Hạ} directly at Hạ who is just off frame; black marble lobby behind.
shot.vid: Vivian looks {Vivian→Lâm Hạ} at Hạ, her smile sharpening. Static camera.
shot.ket: Vivian takes a half step {Vivian→Lâm Hạ} toward Hạ

bt: Sơ mi trắng dính cà phê
shot.hd: Hai người cùng khung: Vivian bước sát, vươn tay tới thẻ trên ngực Hạ; Hạ nhìn Vivian, cảnh giác
shot.anh: Medium two-shot over Vivian's shoulder: Vivian's burgundy shoulder and the back of her head in the foreground at frame edge, her arm reaching across toward the white staff badge on Hạ's chest; Hạ, holding her box, faces the camera side and looks warily at Vivian.
shot.vid: Vivian's hand reaches for the badge on Hạ's chest; Hạ stiffens and looks at Vivian. Static camera.
shot.mo: Vivian's hand starts to reach toward Hạ's chest

bt: Sơ mi trắng dính cà phê
shot.hd: Cận chèn: ngón tay Vivian nắm chặt tấm thẻ
shot.vid: Vivian's fingers tighten their grip on the badge card. Only the hand moves. Static camera.
shot.mo: Vivian's red-nailed fingers close around the badge card
shot.ket: Vivian yanks the badge sharply away from Hạ

bt: Sơ mi trắng dính cà phê
shot.hd: Hai người cùng khung (qua vai Hạ): Vivian giật mạnh, dây thẻ đứt, Hạ chúi về trước
shot.anh: Medium two-shot over Hạ's shoulder: Hạ's dark hair and white blouse shoulder in the foreground at frame edge; facing camera, Vivian pulls her fist back hard with the white badge in it, the dark blue lanyard snapped, as Hạ is jerked half a step forward.
shot.vid: Vivian yanks her fist back; the lanyard snaps and Hạ is jerked forward. Static camera.
shot.mo: Vivian yanks the badge back hard
shot.ket: the snapped lanyard ends swing in Vivian's fist

bt: Sơ mi trắng dính cà phê
shot.hd: Cận Hạ: sững sờ, nhìn Vivian
shot.anh: Close-up of Hạ, stunned, mouth slightly open, her eyes {Lâm Hạ→Vivian} on Vivian just off frame; no lanyard on her neck anymore.
shot.vid: Hạ stares {Lâm Hạ→Vivian} at Vivian in shock. Static camera.
shot.mo: Hạ has just been jerked forward
shot.ket: Hạ's eyes drop to Vivian's fist

shot.hd: Cận chèn: thẻ nằm trong nắm tay Vivian, hai đầu dây đứt lủng lẳng
shot.vid: The two loose lanyard ends sway below Vivian's fist. Static camera.
shot.mo: the snapped lanyard ends swing below Vivian's fist
shot.ket: the fist begins to rise up out of frame

shot.hd: Vivian giơ thẻ ngang mặt cười đắc ý với Hạ; chuông thang máy vang, cô liếc về phía cửa thang
shot.anh: Medium close-up of Vivian holding the white staff badge up beside her face, triumphant smile, eyes {Vivian→Lâm Hạ} on Hạ just off frame.
shot.vid: Vivian holds the badge up, smiling at Hạ; at the chime her eyes flick {Vivian→thang} toward the elevator door. Static camera.
shot.mo: Vivian raises the badge beside her face, smiling at Hạ
shot.ket: an elevator chime sounds; Vivian's eyes flick {Vivian→thang} toward the elevator door

bt: Sơ mi trắng dính cà phê
shot.hd: Cửa thang máy mở, Lục Thần bước ra, Hạ đang đứng chắn ngay cửa
shot.anh: Wide shot of the same lobby: the steel elevator door slides open and Lục Thần in a black three-piece suit steps out, finding Hạ with her box standing right in his way; Vivian, holding the badge, stands beside Hạ.
shot.vid: The elevator door opens; Lục Thần steps out and stops, Hạ right in his path. Static camera.
shot.mo: the elevator door is already sliding open
shot.ket: Lục Thần stops in front of Hạ, cold

shot.hd: Cận Lục Thần lạnh lùng, không nhìn Hạ
shot.vid: Lục Thần speaks without turning his head, face still and cold. Static camera.
shot.mo: Lục Thần stands in the elevator doorway, eyes straight ahead
shot.ket: he finishes the line without once looking at Hạ

thoai.loi: Người ngoài thì đừng đứng chắn thang máy.
thoai.dien_xuat: không dừng bước, không nhìn Hạ

bt: Sơ mi trắng dính cà phê
shot.hd: Cận Hạ nén lại, mím môi, cụp mắt
shot.vid: Hạ presses her lips together and lowers her eyes. Static camera.
shot.mo: Hạ has just heard his words and presses her lips together
shot.ket: Hạ lowers her eyes and stays silent

shot.hd: Vivian lắc tấm thẻ trước mặt Hạ, nói khinh miệt
shot.anh: Medium close-up of Vivian dangling the white staff badge by its snapped lanyard in front of her, mocking smile, eyes {Vivian→Lâm Hạ} on Hạ just off frame.
shot.vid: Vivian swings the badge slowly like a pendulum while speaking, eyes on Hạ, smug and controlled — no frowning. Static camera.
shot.mo: Vivian is already swinging the badge, eyes on Hạ
shot.ket: Vivian finishes and tilts her head, waiting for Hạ to break

thoai.loi: Thẻ của công ty. Loại như cô, đừng mơ bước vào toà nhà này lần nữa.

bt: Sơ mi trắng dính cà phê
shot.hd: Cận Hạ ngẩng lên nhìn Vivian, khẽ nhếch môi, nói, rồi quay về phía thang máy
shot.anh: Close-up of Hạ lifting her eyes {Lâm Hạ→Vivian} to Vivian just off frame, calm, the faintest smirk at one corner of her mouth.
shot.vid: Hạ looks {Lâm Hạ→Vivian} at Vivian, calm, a faint knowing smirk as she speaks softly; then she turns her head {Lâm Hạ→thang} toward the elevator. Very slow push-in.
shot.mo: Hạ slowly lifts her eyes to Vivian
shot.ket: after speaking, Hạ turns {Lâm Hạ→thang} toward the open elevator

thoai.loi: Chị nói đúng. Lần sau, tôi sẽ không đi cửa này.

shot.hd: Cận Vivian: nụ cười khựng lại, mắt nhìn theo Hạ đi vào thang máy
shot.anh: Close-up of Vivian's face, her smug smile stiffening, eyes following {Vivian→thang} toward the elevator; no badge or hands in frame.
shot.vid: Vivian's smile stiffens and drains away as her eyes follow {Vivian→thang} toward the elevator. Static camera.
shot.mo: Vivian's smile stiffens as Hạ turns away
shot.ket: Vivian's eyes stay {Vivian→thang} on the elevator

bt: Sơ mi trắng dính cà phê
shot.hd: Hạ đứng trong thang máy ôm thùng, cửa thép khép dần
shot.vid: The steel elevator doors slide closed in front of Hạ, who stays still facing out. Static camera.
shot.mo: Hạ stands inside the elevator facing out, hugging the box
shot.ket: the steel doors slide shut in front of her calm face
